data.name: Sargun
data.gender_notes: Sargun is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sargun is derived from the Sanskrit word Sar, which means 'that which is in motion' and Gun, which means 'progress'. This name signifies continuous progress and motion, both in physical and spiritual aspects of life. The name Sargun carries the meaning “Motion, Progress” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sargun usually hope their child will grow to embody motion, progress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sargun is a powerful name that represents the divine energy of progress and motion. It is believed to bring grace, beauty and power to the bearer.
data.etymology: Sargun belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Motion, Progress.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sargun total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
